expect_red: a feature row selects its node, an interface row its element, a fold is the row's own, and a show/hide box names its part or body

mutations.contract: A feature row hands back its own feature id (part@node), so the faces layer opens under the row clicked.
mutations.note: Hands back the node id instead, which loses which of a shared node's two features was clicked.

mutations.contract: A body's show/hide box reports the body, so every part of it is shown or hidden together.
mutations.note: Reports the body's first part instead of the body, which hides one part when the reader unticked a body.
mutations.find: var box = visibility("body", body.id, hiddenCount < meshed.length,
mutations.replace: var box = visibility("part", body.parts[0], hiddenCount < meshed.length,
